name: Jellyfin + Bonfire
description: Official Jellyfin Web client patched with the Bonfire loader for multi-user profile switching. Requires the Bonfire plugin on your Jellyfin server.
pre_build: set -e; (cd ../jellyfin-web && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npm exec --yes --package=node@24 --package=npm@11 -- sh -c 'npm ci --no-audit && USE_SYSTEM_FONTS=1 npm run build:production'); JELLYFIN_WEB_DIR=../jellyfin-web/dist npm ci --no-audit; curl -fsSL -o www/bonfire-loader.js https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AHouseOfBards/Bonfire-JellyProfiles/main/Web/tizen/bonfire-loader.js; sed -i 's#</body>#<script src="bonfire-loader.js"></script></body>#' www/index.html; grep -q bonfire-loader.js www/index.html; rm -rf node_modules gulpfile.babel.js package.json package-lock.json
